limitations: This is an inventory of consequential model/training/runtime families, not a claim that every raw execution attempt was individually reread.
Historical acceptance and timing panels are reused development; modern held-out correctness qualification does not retroactively qualify historical runtimes.
Some historical reports cite external archived paths; the latest closure and compact precision inventory were read locally.
Full historical preparation/training/search costs are not reconciled; preserve per-lineage accounting and do not add overlapping clocks.
